coverage_override.reason: The hand summon trigger, banishment-summon Synchro trigger, optional non-Tuner treatment, and shared HOPT are four audit units.

effects.printed_clause: If a card you control is banished: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed hand EVENT_REMOVE trigger now requires an event card to have been previously controlled by the player and previously located on the field, then checks zone and summon legality before Special Summoning the related handler.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a hand-range Special Summon trigger with event-group qualification and summon legality checks.

effects.issue: Fixed: cards banished from the hand, Deck, GY, or Extra Deck no longer satisfy the printed 'card you control' condition.

effects.printed_clause: If you Special Summon a monster from your banishment: reveal a Synchro Monster; immediately after resolution, Synchro Summon it using monsters you control.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS field trigger identifies a monster summoned by the controller from banishment, confirms a currently summonable Synchro from the Extra Deck, retains it, and calls Duel.SynchroSummon after the effect resolves if it remains legal.

official_references.matched_structure: Confirms an Extra Deck Synchro and performs a constrained follow-up Synchro Summon.

effects.printed_clause: When resolving this effect, you can treat this card as a non-Tuner.
effects.lua_implementation: The Synchro legality probe and operation can temporarily register EFFECT_NONTUNER on the handler for the selected Summon, reset after the probe/Chain.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses EFFECT_NONTUNER to alter Synchro-material tuner treatment for a Summon.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Interwire Dimensquid once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The hand summon and Synchro triggers use distinct id and id+100 hard count keys.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses id-derived hard once-per-turn handling on distinct Synchro-related effects.
